name: subtitle-translate
title: Subtitle Translate
description: Dual-language stacked subtitles: the lead line arrives first, the translation follows a few frames later in a smaller, quieter size, with optional language tags.
useWhen: A video needs subtitles in two languages at once: the spoken language and its translation.
Cues and translations are known per line (from a subtitle export or a translator).
avoidWhen: You need word-by-word highlighting: use a word-timed caption block.
A single language: use a plain caption block.
author: RemotionUI

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: JSON list [{"text","translation","startMs","endMs"}] (or start/end in seconds). Nothing shows between cues.
variables.default: [{"text": "Welcome back to the studio.", "translation": "Selamat datang kembali di studio.", "startMs": 400, "endMs": 3200}, {"text": "Today we are shooting a short film.", "translation": "Hari ini kita syuting film pendek.", "startMs": 3700, "endMs": 6800}, {"text": "Keep the camera steady and the light soft.", "translation": "Jaga kamera tetap stabil dan cahaya tetap lembut.", "startMs": 7300, "endMs": 10800}]

variables.label: Lead line
variables.description: Which language is the large lead line.

variables.label: Source tag
variables.description: Language tag shown beside the source line, for example EN. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Translation tag
variables.description: Language tag shown beside the translation. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Second line scale
variables.description: Size of the second line relative to the lead.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Colour of the card behind the subtitles.

variables.label: Background opacity
variables.description: Opacity of the card behind the subtitles.

variables.label: Max width
variables.description: Widest the card gets, as a percent of the frame.

variables.label: Enter
variables.description: Frames (30 per second) a line takes to arrive.

variables.label: Second line delay
variables.description: Frames the second line trails the first.
